usage_rules.headings: Use tight tracking (-0.02em) for sizes over 24px.

hero_bg.usage: Landing page hero background with overlay

icons.instructions: Use Lucide React for all UI icons. Use Phosphor Icons (Duotone) for feature highlights if needed.

dashboard_grid.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-4 auto-rows-[minmax(180px,auto)]

landing_page.hero: Full viewport height (min-h-screen), asymmetric text placement

buttons.secondary: bg-secondary/10 text-secondary hover:bg-secondary/20 transition-colors rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium

inputs.default: bg-background border-input ring-offset-background focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary rounded-lg

gamification.xp_bar: Gradient progress bar (from accent to primary)
gamification.badges: Neumorphic style or glassmorphism with vivid icons

ai_assistant.trigger: Floating Action Button (bottom-right) or Integrated Chat Sidebar
ai_assistant.style: Glassmorphic bubble with pulsing glow effect

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use 'Inter' for Headings. Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans'.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry.
DO NOT use full-screen solid flat colors. Use noise/grain or subtle gradients.
ALWAYS add a 'data-testid' to interactive elements.
Dark mode should use 'slate-900' or 'zinc-950', NEVER pure black '#000000'.
Interactive elements must have a scale-down effect on click (active:scale-95).
instructions_to_main_agent: Use 'recharts' for the grades analytics and progress tracking.
Implement the 'Theme Customizer' using CSS variables in a root provider.
For the Timeline/Calendar, use a custom grid implementation or a library like 'react-big-calendar' styled heavily.
Ensure the 'Papillon AI' chat interface feels conversational and integrated, not just an overlay.
Use 'framer-motion' for page transitions and list staggered entrances.
